findings.title: Page's attempt line is off by one — prints stored `attempts` (completed count), showing "attempt: 0" on a first attempt
`orchid notify` new arg loop refuses message text that begins with `-` (old code accepted it as text)
`orchid answer` choices-scrape can misread a no-set question whose body's first line is `choices: <comma-words>` (whitespace guard doesn't cover it) as a declared set, gating free text
